summary: Comprehensive frontend E2E testing of RIONA PARFUM SPA against live Firebase/Cloudinary. Verified home, catalog, product detail, quick view, wishlist, scent quiz, gift finder, cart bundle+giftwrap+tester+promo, user register/login, order via WhatsApp (Firestore order creation + cashback), admin protection, admin dashboard, admin products with Cloudinary upload (create+delete), admin coupons CRUD, admin orders status update. All critical flows PASS. A few minor testability/spec gaps found.

testability_gaps.issue: Filter chips (gender/family/character/season/mood) have NO data-testid attributes. Review spec explicitly requires gender-chip-*, family-chip-*, character-chip-Tünd/Şirin/Təravətli, season-chip-Sərin, mood-chip-*. Only catalog-search + catalog-grid have testids. Filters work functionally, but automation cannot address them by id.
cart-badge and wishlist-badge data-testids are missing. Only nav-cart / nav-wishlist wrap the count. Spec references cart-badge/wishlist-badge selectors.

Only 5 featured products render (5 seeded products have featured=true). Spec says 8. Home.jsx already falls back to all products when featured is empty but not when partially featured. Consider slicing all products to 8 if fewer than 8 are featured.

verified_flows: Home loads, no removed Fast Delivery / Guaranteed Purchase cards
Language switcher opens dropdown and switches AZ/EN/RU (lang-option-* appear when open)
Catalog shows 8 seeded products; catalog-search filters (Noir -> 1 result)
Product detail: perfume-pyramid, variant-0/1/2 changes line-total (18->32), qty-plus doubles total (64), add-to-cart shows toast
QuickView modal opens with qv-variant-* and qv-add-cart works
Wishlist toggle works; /wishlist lists favourited items

Cart: 3 different products triggers bundle-banner and 15% discount (-8.40 on 56 subtotal). giftwrap-toggle adds +3 and reveals gift-message. Subtotal >50 reveals tester-section with tester-select. Invalid promo shows 'Code not found or inactive' toast. Valid RIONA10 reduces total 34->30.60.
Register new user (auth-toggle -> auth-name/email/password -> auth-submit) redirects to /account
WhatsApp checkout: opens wa.me tab AND creates Firestore order (visible in /admin/orders and /account order history). Cashback = 5% of total (47.60 -> 2.38 points).
Account: cashback-points shown, reorder button adds items back
Admin login (admin@rionaparfum.com / Riona2026!) grants access; nav-admin link appears
Admin Dashboard: stat-revenue/orders/users/products render real counts (47.60 / 1 / 2 / 8) with recent orders

Admin Products: add-product-btn opens modal, product-image-upload uploads to Cloudinary (secure_url returned res.cloudinary.com/dhz3lvda/...), save-product creates product, delete-product-* removes it
Admin Coupons: create-coupon creates RIONA10 (percent 10), visible in list, applies on Cart
Admin Orders: order-status-processing-* updates status successfully
critical_code_review_comments: Add data-testid to Catalog filter chips per spec (gender/family/character/season/mood) to enable stable automation.
Add data-testid='cart-badge' and 'wishlist-badge' to the count spans inside Header nav-cart / nav-wishlist links.
Home.jsx: featured slice fallback should also fill up when featured length < 8 (currently only falls back if length is 0).

ScentQuiz modal-close testid: request references 'quiz-close' via generic Modal; ensure the built-in close button on ScentQuiz uses a consistent data-testid so tests can dismiss it reliably (current close works via Modal internal button but sometimes intercepts subsequent clicks).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@rionaparfum.com / Riona2026!  (login worked; already registered)
seed_data_creation: Created 1 coupon RIONA10 (10% percent) and 1 user tester1787388926@example.com; 1 order recorded. Test product TEST_Elixir was created via admin and deleted at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Only cosmetic testability gaps remain: missing data-testid on catalog filter chips, missing cart-badge/wishlist-badge testids, and Home featured slice only shows products with featured=true (5) instead of filling up to 8. Admin credentials work with Riona2026!. Cloudinary uploads via unsigned preset 'riona_unsigned' work. WhatsApp checkout creates real Firestore orders.
